description: One row per registered Power Platform application/solution this system documents.

columns.name: Title
columns.notes: Human-readable application name (also used as the document library folder name, sanitized).

columns.name: ApplicationId
columns.notes: Application-generated stable ID (e.g. a slug). SharePoint does not enforce uniqueness on this column — enforce it in the Power App / worker.

columns.name: SolutionName
columns.notes: The Power Platform solution's unique name (not its display name).

columns.name: Environment
columns.notes: Extend choices to match real environment names once known — see docs/CORPORATE_SETUP.md Phase 1.

columns.name: EnvironmentUrl
columns.notes: REQUIRES TENANT CONFIGURATION — leave blank until known. A plain text URL, not a Hyperlink column — see docs/SHAREPOINT_SETUP.md for why.

columns.name: CurrentVersion
columns.notes: Written by the worker, e.g. '1.1'. Do not edit manually.

columns.name: TechnicalDocumentationUrl
columns.notes: Written by the worker after generation. A plain text URL, not a Hyperlink column — see docs/SHAREPOINT_SETUP.md for why.

columns.name: UserDocumentationUrl
columns.notes: Written by the worker after generation. A plain text URL, not a Hyperlink column — see docs/SHAREPOINT_SETUP.md for why.
